# Carousel

```tsx
import { Carousel, CarouselContent, CarouselItem, CarouselPrevious, CarouselNext, CarouselIndicators, CarouselControls, useCarousel } from "@s0l/design-system"
```

Shows one slide at a time with arrows and indicators. Mirrors the Figma Carousel: Items (2 / 3 / 4 / 5 / > 5) × Current Item (First / Mid / Last). Above 5 slides only 5 indicators show, and an end one shrinks while more slides sit past it. Arrow keys, the arrows, the indicators and swiping all change the slide.

## Figma notes

Mirrors the Figma Carousel: the Slot (CarouselContent with the slides) and, 24px below, the Controls: Button Ghost arrows at both ends and the Indicators between them. Items (2 / 3 / 4 / 5 / > 5) × Current Item come from the slides and the selected one. Above 5 slides only 5 indicators show, and an end one shrinks to 8px while more slides sit past it.

## Props

Documented props only; every component also accepts the props of the element or Base UI part it renders (`className`, events, ARIA…).

`CarouselProps`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `opts?` | `CarouselOptions` | Embla options. `loop` is on by default, so the arrows never dead-end. |

`CarouselContextProps`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | `number` | Number of slides (Figma Items) and the selected one (Current Item). |

`CarouselIndicators`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `getLabel?` | `(index: number) => string` | Accessible name of each indicator. |

## Rules

- Import `Carousel` from `@s0l/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
